course.title: Statistics for Planners-I
course.department: Department of Urban and Regional Planning

content.value: A firm conducted a survey to study whether changes in office design increase productivity. 70% workers said that reducing noise would increase productivity. 67% workers said that more storage space would increase productivity. 56% workers said that both noise reduction and increased storage space would improve productivity. If a worker is randomly selected and asked what changes in office design would increase worker productivity, what is the probability that this person would select reducing noise or more storage space?

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 2nd Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2018
